::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Dedicated industrial-gas supply for Tata Electronics' Dholera fab — bulk gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon) are a basic but essential fab input; without a local ASU, Tata's fab would depend on trucked-in supply, a real bottleneck at fab scale.
:::

## What does this facility supply?

Bulk industrial gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon) via on-site air separation, piped directly to Tata's Dholera fab.

## Project Timeline

- **16 Sep 2026** — Reported under construction, targeting operational readiness in H2 2027 ahead of Tata's fab ramp
